name: hbm_qcore_s_pinrung_r1-s900-r1-COMMIT
purpose: Actual integrated S=a89a10d1f MUT0,COLLPORT1 qcore. 64 independently clocked flop RF banks (six bounded4word replicas), two real reducer128x256 SRAMs, clk_ctl and clk_red. Full component nativebench and negative controls; no whole-SU claim. Production serial900MHz, phi-R per actual root, no stage changes. Outline chosen from honest synthesis count; all source RF relay outputs/capture grouped N, RR/SFU E, slice W. PHYS_RF_INGRESS1 structural pin-rung relocation keeps normal production cycles exactly S; write-conflict fault status +1 edge. Default0 retains legacy source. Compact276.48square replaces inflated250x2671.92 target based on actual mapped37186.64um2.

Explicit normal edge equivalence vs preserved actual S core; write-conflict sticky status +1 edge only, no normal execution or bandwidth change.
